description: Quantity plural agreement (Step 5 / L4). Rule en-l4-quantity-plural-s pluralizes a whitelisted singular count noun (apple/book/hat/lesson/orange/student/word) when it follows a plural quantity word (two/three/many/some/several). Expectations encode the VERIFIED behaviour of correctWithTutorRules() on current main.
fp_risk_note: Pluralization must fire only on a recognized quantity word + a whitelisted singular count noun. The negative cases stress: (1) nouns already pluralized ('two books') — re-pluralizing would yield 'bookss'; (2) non-whitelisted nouns ('cats') the rule does not own; (3) uncountable nouns after a quantifier ('some water') which must stay singular. A regression that broadens the noun set or the quantity set must re-check these.

negative.notes: FP-stress (already plural): 'two books' is correct; rule must not double-pluralize.
FP-stress (non-whitelisted noun): 'cat' is not in the rule's noun set; rule must abstain.
FP-stress (uncountable after quantifier): 'some water' must stay singular.
FP guard (irregular plural, non-whitelisted): 'children' is already plural and 'child' is not in the noun set; rule must abstain.

negative.input: How many books do you have?
negative.expectedCorrection: How many books do you have?
negative.notes: FP guard (question, already plural): 'many books' is correct inside a wh question.
FP guard (quantifier outside the set): 'few' is not in two/three/many/some/several, so even a whitelisted noun must not be re-pluralized.
FP guard (irregular plural): 'mice' is already plural and 'mouse' is not whitelisted; rule must abstain.

negative.input: I want some book a room.
negative.expectedCorrection: I want some book a room.
negative.notes: Lock (verb-sense guard): 'book' is the verb (to book a room), not a quantified noun; quantity-plural must not pluralize it.

negative.input: I want some book a room.
negative.expectedCorrection: I want some book a room.
